text: EX-99.1 2 d187492dex991.htm EX-99.1 EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 1350 Avenue of the Americas New York, NY 10019 Press Release CRH completes $8.5B acquisition of Arcosa NEW YORK – October 23, 2026 – CRH (NYSE: CRH), the leading provider of building materials, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Arcosa, Inc. CRH previously announced on June 22, 2026 that it had reached an agreement to acquire Arcosa, a leading U.S. provider of aggregates and critical infrastructure products, for a total enterprise value of approximately $8.5 billion. The completed acquisition is highly complementary to CRH, advancing the company’s aggregates-led, connected portfolio strategy. The transaction reinforces CRH’s position as the leader in U.S. and global aggregates, and increases its exposure to demand from major road, water, energy and data projects across the country. Jim Mintern, CRH CEO, said: “Arcosa is an excellent strategic fit for CRH and fully aligns with our growth ambitions. With high-quality aggregates assets and attractive positions in the growing U.S. energy transmission market, the acquisition strengthens our connected portfolio and reinforces our position as the #1 infrastructure player in North America. We look forward to welcoming our Arcosa colleagues into CRH and executing on the strong growth opportunities ahead.” CRH will provide updated full-year 2026 guidance reflecting the completion of the Arcosa acquisition with its third-quarter results on October 29. **** Contacts Danilo Juvane Lauren Schulz Head of Investor Relations Chief Communications Officer Danilo.Juvane@crh.com Lauren.Schulz@crh.com About CRH CRH is the leading provider of building materials critical to modernizing infrastructure. With our team of 83,000 people across 4,000 locations, our unmatched scale, connected portfolio, and deep local relationships make us the partner of choice for transportation, water, and reindustrialization projects, shaping communities for a better tomorrow. CRH (NYSE: CRH) is a member of the S&P 500 Index. For more information, visit www.crh.com .
